svg.title: Lifecycle tiers on the hot account, GRS copy of the cool one
svg.desc: In the hot account (LRS, Hot tier) the lifecycle rule moves a block blob such as samples/hello.txt to Cool 30 days after its last change and deletes it after 365 days. The cool account (GRS, Cool tier) is copied from the session's region to its paired region, for example UK South to UK West.
